1	import { defineStore } from 'pinia'
2	import { ref } from 'vue'
3	import api from '@/composables/useApi'
4	
5	export const usePortfolioStore = defineStore('portfolio', () => {
6	  const positions = ref([])
7	  const totalValue = ref(0)
8	  const totalCost = ref(0)
9	  const totalPnl = ref(0)
10	  const totalPnlPercent = ref(0)
11	  const loading = ref(false)
12	
13	  async function fetchPortfolio() {
14	    loading.value = true
15	    try {
16	      const data = await api.get('/portfolio')
17	      positions.value = data.positions
18	      totalValue.value = data.totalValue
19	      totalCost.value = data.totalCost
20	      totalPnl.value = data.totalPnl
21	      totalPnlPercent.value = data.totalPnlPercent
22	    } finally {
23	      loading.value = false
24	    }
25	  }
26	
27	  async function addTransaction(payload) {
28	    const data = await api.post('/portfolio/transaction', payload)
29	    await fetchPortfolio()
30	    return data
31	  }
32	
33	  async function deletePosition(id) {
34	    await api.delete(`/portfolio/position/${id}`)
35	    await fetchPortfolio()
36	  }
37	
38	  return { positions, totalValue, totalCost, totalPnl, totalPnlPercent, loading, fetchPortfolio, addTransaction, deletePosition }
39	})
